name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-action@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cd compiler && cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Lint
        run: cd compiler && cargo clippy -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cd compiler && cargo test --all

      - name: Build
        run: cd compiler && cargo build --release
